svg.aria-label: Stage UI mockup: connection form with credentials taken from a vault
svg.title: Stage UI mockup: connection form with credentials taken from a vault
svg.text: Create a connection by filling the form below. It can be used by both sources and destinations.
ecommerce database, credentials from the secret store
Add a one liner to describe this connection or what it is used for.
Validate is off: the platform cannot read a vault, so it cannot test these credentials.
The connection stores references. The values stay in the secret store,
and the pipeline pod fetches them itself when it starts.
Every username, password or token field gets this switch. “Value” keeps
today’s behaviour, a typed value with the show/hide eye. “Vault” replaces
the input with a menu of the keys the registered vaults serve.
No free text: a reference can only point at a registered vault.
Mockup for DDD-67, not final UI
